cases.title: Publish is refused when no participants are added
cases.expected: Publishing stops. The message "Please add participants to proceed!" appears.
cases.setup: Open a valid auction project with no participants. Leave the product sheet valid and enter a project title.

cases.title: Save as draft becomes available only for eligible projects
steps: Verify the state of "Save as draft".
Repeat with draft project creation disabled or with a recurring stage.
cases.expected: "Save as draft" is enabled only when all eligibility conditions are met. It is disabled when draft project creation is unavailable or the project is recurring.
cases.setup: Use a project that is not an RFQ-to-Auction conversion, is not a recurring stage, is not routed to the Auction Team, and is not a service-RFP grouping. Enable draft project creation for the tenant.
gaps: Whether Save as draft is disabled when draft project creation is disabled by a tenant setting.

cases.title: Publishing without an end time is rejected
cases.expected: Publishing fails with the message "Please add end time for the event".
cases.setup: Open a valid project with at least one participant and a valid title.

cases.title: Publish confirmation uses the Auction Team wording
cases.expected: The modal title is "Send to Auction Team". The project title shown in the modal is truncated to 45 characters. The modal shows "Publish Event" and an OK action labeled "Send to Auction Team".
cases.setup: Configure the event to publish to the Auction Team. Add participants and enter a project title longer than 45 characters.
gaps: Exact character-count validation that the project title is truncated to precisely 45 characters, including whether an ellipsis is rendered.

cases.title: Locked product fields cannot be edited during RFQ-to-Auction conversion
steps: Try to edit a cell under "Product".
Try to edit a cell under "Quantity Requested".
Try to replace the product or quantity value.
cases.expected: The product and requested quantity cells are read-only. No product or quantity value can be changed from this screen.
cases.setup: Open quick-create from an existing RFQ and select an Auction event using the existing BOQ template.
gaps: Directly attempting to replace the Product or Quantity Requested values and asserting the edit is refused.
Verifying that no product or quantity value changed after an attempted edit.
The conversion-specific explanatory copy stating that product changes are unavailable.

cases.title: Ask Clara opens the summary panel in the disabled-Clara configuration
cases.expected: The Clara summary panel renders and displays the project's existing summary.
cases.setup: Use a project that has a claraSummary and a tenant where Clara is disabled.
gaps: Configure the tenant with Clara disabled.
Provide or verify the project's existing Clara summary content.

cases.title: Publish opens the event confirmation
cases.expected: A confirmation dialog appears with the title "Publish Event". The dialog shows an OK action labeled "Publish" and a cancel action labeled "Edit Schedule". Choosing "Edit Schedule" opens the schedule drawer.
cases.setup: Use a valid BOQ with a project title, required line-item values, and at least one participant.

cases.title: Changing the selected BOQ shows a reset warning
steps: Do not confirm the template change.
cases.expected: A warning appears stating "Changing template will reset data. Are you sure?". The confirmation option is labeled "Yes".
cases.setup: Open the screen with the current BOQ populated with at least one line item.

cases.title: Save as draft is disabled on the initial screen
cases.expected: "Save as draft" is visibly disabled and cannot be activated. No draft-save action starts.
cases.setup: Open the screen in its initial state.

cases.title: Add Attachments opens the attachment interface
cases.expected: An attachment picker or attachment panel opens, allowing the tester to begin adding an attachment without leaving the BOQ creation screen.
gaps: Whether a native browser file picker opens
The exact attachment panel or picker controls and whether they allow beginning an upload

cases.title: Rank on lot opens lot-ranking configuration
cases.expected: The lot-ranking auction configuration opens. It shows rank-based evaluation for the lot rather than product-level ranking.
cases.setup: Open the BOQ auction creation screen.
